figures.caption: Figure 1: The overview of Speaker-Reasoner. The model employs an agentic multi-turn reasoning mechanism on the temporal axis, utilizing an indexing and slicing tool and a speaker-aware context cache to iteratively generate speaker identity, gender, timestamps, and transcription from raw multi-speaker audio.

Table 1: Comparison of speaker diarization and recognition performance on AISHELL4-Eval and Alimeeting-Far test sets. The proposed models also serve as a stage-wise ablation across training stages. Bold denotes the best result in each column.
